comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: If you can enter the Paraguay River Upstream landing zone, that may be the best spot of all; you can fish for them due east of the entry/exit point. I caught only these and piranha, with an occasional dorado, almost non-stop. Being inland, there's no disasters like rats or fires to worry about, too.
